validation.unit: seed 4108, full FP32 [16,256,256] output per run, ORT CPU reference

phase_diagnosis.statistic: 1 warmup plus 3 alternating measured runs for each version and instrumentation mode
phase_diagnosis.scope: Last-finishing callback wall intervals. Its before/after latencies and in-callback bookkeeping separate scheduling from packed panels and multiply/writeback. Worker WFI and descheduling are not separated by guest rdtime. Main wait/WFI overlap other cores' computations; percentages use each run's dispatch wall.

phase_confirmation.statistic: 1 warmup and 3 measured runs per variant and mode, with alternating order
phase_confirmation.scope: Elapsed guest time on the last-finishing core, including memory access and vCPU descheduling. Main-core wait/WFI overlaps work on other cores.
